papers.title: Short-Course Radiotherapy-Based Total Neoadjuvant Therapy plus Tislelizumab for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer (Neo-STAR): Early Outcomes of a Randomized Phase II Trial
papers.ptype: Clinical Trial, Phase II, Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Wu F, Hu X, Li B, Zhang J, Wang G, Fan H
papers.abstract: Background: Short-course radiotherapy (SCRT)-based total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) is used for locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC). However, the pathological complete response (pCR) rate still hovers around 30%. Radiotherapy and immune checkpoint inhibitors have been shown to exert synergistic anticancer effects. This phase II randomized clinical trial aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SCRT followed by capecitabine plus oxaliplatin (CAPOX) and tislelizumab versus SCRT followed by CAPOX alone in LARC. Methods: Patients initially diagnosed with clinical tumor stage 1 to 2, with node involvement and no distant metastasis (cT1-2N+M0) or clinical tumor stage 3 to 4, with any node status and no distant metastasis (cT3-4NanyM0) rectal adenocarcinoma were randomly assigned to receive SCRT (25 Gy in 5 fractions [25 Gy/5F]), followed by 4 cycles of CAPOX combined with tislelizumab (SCRT-TNT-ICI) or CAPOX alone (SCRT-TNT). After total mesorectal excision, 2 cycles of postoperative chemotherapy were administered according to the patient's preference. The primary end point was the pCR rate, and secondary end points included major pathological response (tumor regression grade 0 or 1), 3-year progression-free survival, 3-year overall survival, and adverse events. Results: Between September 2021 and March 2024, 118 patients were randomized, of whom 111 started the allocated treatment, with 53 and 58 in SCRT-TNT-ICI and SCRT-TNT groups, respectively. Of those, 89 patients had surgical resection, including 45 in the SCRT-TNT-ICI group and 44 in the SCRT-TNT group. The pCR rate was 45.3% (95% confidence interval [CI], 31.5% to 59.8%) in the SCRT-TNT-ICI group compared to 27.6% (95% CI, 16.6% to 40.8%) in the SCRT-TNT group (odds ratio = 2.17; 95% CI, 0.99 to 4.79; P = 0.052). The major pathological response rates were 50.9% (95% CI, 36.6% to 65.2%) and 31.0% (95% CI, 19.5% to 44.6%), respectively (odds ratio = 2.31; 95% CI, 1.06 to 5.01; P = 0.033). During the neoadjuvant treatment period, the incidence of grade 3 to 4 adverse events was comparable between the SCRT-TNT-ICI and SCRT-TNT groups, with anemia being the most common in both groups. Conclusion: This phase II study provides preliminary evidence of promising tumor regression with SCRT-TNT combined with tislelizumab in LARC, warranting further validation in phase III trials. Trial registration: This trial was registered at clinicaltrials.gov (Identifier: NCT05086627).

papers.title_zh: 以短程放療為基礎的全程新輔助治療併用替雷利珠單抗治療局部進展期直腸癌（Neo-STAR研究）：一項隨機第二期試驗的早期結果
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：以短程放療（SCRT）為基礎的全程新輔助治療（TNT）已用於局部進展期直腸癌（LARC），但病理完全緩解（pCR）率仍徘徊在約30%。放療與免疫檢查點抑制劑已顯示具協同抗癌效果。本第二期隨機臨床試驗旨在評估SCRT後接續CAPOX（卡培他濱+奧沙利鉑）併用替雷利珠單抗（SCRT-TNT-ICI）相較於SCRT後單純CAPOX（SCRT-TNT）於LARC病人之療效與安全性。方法：初診斷為臨床腫瘤分期1至2期合併淋巴結轉移且無遠端轉移（cT1-2N+M0），或臨床腫瘤分期3至4期任何淋巴結狀態且無遠端轉移（cT3-4NanyM0）之直腸腺癌病人，隨機分配接受SCRT（25 Gy分5次照射），後續接受4個週期CAPOX併用替雷利珠單抗（SCRT-TNT-ICI組）或單純CAPOX（SCRT-TNT組）。全直腸系膜切除術（TME）後，依病人意願給予2個週期術後化療。主要終點為pCR率，次要終點包括主要病理反應率（腫瘤退縮分級0或1）、3年無進展存活期、3年整體存活期及不良事件。結果：2021年9月至2024年3月間，118名病人被隨機分配，其中111名開始接受分配治療（SCRT-TNT-ICI組53人、SCRT-TNT組58人）。其中89名病人接受手術切除，SCRT-TNT-ICI組45人、SCRT-TNT組44人。SCRT-TNT-ICI組pCR率為45.3%（95%信賴區間[CI] 31.5%至59.8%），SCRT-TNT組為27.6%（95% CI 16.6%至40.8%）（勝算比[OR]=2.17；95% CI 0.99至4.79；P=0.052）。主要病理反應率分別為50.9%（95% CI 36.6%至65.2%）及31.0%（95% CI 19.5%至44.6%）（OR=2.31；95% CI 1.06至5.01；P=0.033）。新輔助治療期間，兩組3至4級不良事件發生率相近，貧血為兩組最常見之不良事件。結論：本第二期研究提供SCRT-TNT併用替雷利珠單抗於LARC病人中具良好腫瘤退縮之初步證據，尚需第三期試驗進一步驗證。試驗註冊：本試驗已於clinicaltrials.gov註冊（識別碼：NCT05086627）。
papers.score_reason: 設計良好且有試驗註冊之隨機第二期試驗，但主要終點pCR未達統計顯著（p=0.052），樣本量小且僅為早期結果，尚待III期驗證，臨床應用尚早。
papers.relevance_why: TNT為LARC標準治療趨勢，加入免疫治療是台灣直腸癌新輔助治療領域正在關注的方向。
papers.one_liner: 在118名LARC病人中，比較SCRT-TNT併用tislelizumab與單純SCRT-TNT，pCR達45.3% vs 27.6%（p=0.052，未達統計顯著）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變常規做法；SCRT-TNT加ICI仍屬研究性介入，可留意後續III期試驗結果，適合病人可考慮納入臨床試驗。

papers.context: 與清單第3篇（TNT策略安全性比較）同屬LARC全程新輔助治療研究範疇，但研究問題不同：前者比較化療/放療先後順序之毒性，本篇則探討於SCRT-TNT架構中加入免疫治療對病理反應的影響，補上TNT併用ICI的證據缺口。

papers.title: Effect of continuity of patient care on quality of life and psychological state in patients with inflammatory bowel disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.authors: Huang X, Duan H, Zhou X, Wang M, Wang J
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: To systematically evaluate the effectiveness of continuity of patient care on quality of life, anxiety, and depressive symptoms in inflammatory bowel disease.
METHODS: Five databases were systematically searched for relevant studies from inception to March 20, 2026. The primary outcome measure included quality of life, anxiety, and depression state. The tools of Cochrane's risk-of-bias were used to assess bias risks. Then, the fixed effect or the random effect model was applied in the meta-analysis. Continuity variables were expressed as standardized mean difference (SMD) and its 95% confidence interval (95% CI), while dichotomous variables were presented as relative risk (RR) and its 95% CI. Finally, sensitivity and publication bias were performed.
RESULTS: Twelve randomized controlled trials involving 1,246 participants were included. Continuity of patient care significantly improved quality of life (including inflammatory bowel disease questionnaire and 36-item Short Form Health Status Survey), as well as the anxiety (SMD = -1.98, 95% CI [-2.40 to -1.55], p < 0.00001) and depression (SMD = -1.82, 95% CI [-2.67 to -0.98], p < 0.0001) levels of IBD patients. They did not significantly reduce the recurrence rate (SMD = 0.94, 95% CI [0.53-1.67], p = 0.83) and nursing satisfaction (SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.97-1.45], p = 0.10).
CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis revealed that continuity of patient care might improve the quality of life and anxiety and depression levels of patients with inflammatory bowel disease but not the recurrence rate. This meta-analysis provides novel insights into continuity of patient care in the field of IBD. Healthcare workers should practice continuity in patient care for patients with inflammatory bowel disease to improve the quality of life and anxiety and depression. Due to extremely high heterogeneity, we lowered the evidence to a moderate quality level.

papers.title_zh: 延續性照護對發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者生活品質與心理狀態之影響：隨機對照試驗之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：系統性評估延續性照護對發炎性腸道疾病患者生活品質、焦慮與憂鬱症狀的效果。方法：系統性搜尋五個資料庫，從建庫至2026年3月20日的相關研究。主要結果指標包括生活品質、焦慮與憂鬱狀態。使用Cochrane偏誤風險工具評估偏誤風險。依情況採用固定效應或隨機效應模型進行統合分析。連續變項以標準化平均差（SMD）及其95%信賴區間表示，二元變項以相對風險（RR）及其95%信賴區間表示。最後進行敏感性分析與出版偏誤評估。結果：共納入12篇隨機對照試驗，涉及1,246名參與者。延續性照護顯著改善生活品質（包括發炎性腸道疾病問卷與36項簡短健康調查量表），以及焦慮（SMD = -1.98，95% CI [-2.40 至 -1.55]，p < 0.00001）與憂鬱（SMD = -1.82，95% CI [-2.67 至 -0.98]，p < 0.0001）程度。但並未顯著降低復發率（SMD = 0.94，95% CI [0.53-1.67]，p = 0.83）與護理滿意度（SMD = 1.19，95% CI [0.97-1.45]，p = 0.10）。結論：本統合分析顯示延續性照護可能改善IBD患者的生活品質、焦慮與憂鬱程度，但對復發率無影響。本研究為IBD領域中延續性照護提供了新見解。醫療人員應對IBD患者實踐延續性照護以改善其生活品質及焦慮憂鬱狀態。由於異質性極高，證據等級已下調為中等品質。
papers.score_reason: 統合分析雖納入12篇RCT，但異質性極高、證據品質降至中等，且介入為護理端延續性照護而非外科措施，與大腸直腸外科臨床實務關聯性極低。
papers.relevance_why: 此研究聚焦IBD患者護理延續性對心理與生活品質的影響，屬於非手術、非外科介入的照護模式研究。
papers.one_liner: 在12篇RCT共1,246名IBD患者中，比較延續性照護與常規照護，焦慮SMD -1.98、憂鬱SMD -1.82顯著改善，復發率無差異(p=0.83)。
papers.action: 目前不需改變外科做法；此為護理／心理照護介入研究，可轉知IBD多學科照護團隊參考，非手術決策依據。

papers.title: Are gastrointestinal, gynecological and urogenital chronic overlapping pain conditions (COPCs) predisposing or perpetuating factors for orofacial pain (OFP)? A systematic review
papers.authors: Justribó-Manion C, Ignacio de Oliveira J, Van De Meer H, Barbosa da Silva J, Bustins G, Mesa-Jimenez J
papers.abstract: Orofacial pain (OFP) is a multidimensional clinical problem that includes conditions such as temporomandibular disorders (TMD). It is often associated with chronic overlapping pain conditions (COPCs), including gastrointestinal, gynecological and urogenital disorders. Despite previous reviews, uncertainty remains regarding temporality, the effect size and evidence certainty. This systematic review and meta-analysis, registered in PROSPERO, synthesized observational studies assessing the association between COPCs and OFP. Twenty-two studies met the inclusion criteria, of which 12 were eligible for quantitative synthesis. The risk of bias (RoB) was assessed with the Quality in Prognosis Studies (QUIPS) tool, and the certainty of evidence was evaluated using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach. Longitudinal studies demonstrated, with moderate certainty, that irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) increases the risk of both first-onset and chronic OFP, including TMD and burning mouth syndrome. Cross-sectional evidence revealed associations of moderate magnitude between gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and TMD, and large effects between polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and TMD, though with lower certainty due to methodological limitations. Other conditions, such as interstitial cystitis (IC), gastritis, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and endometriosis, were supported by limited and low-certainty evidence. Overall, findings underscore the importance of considering COPCs in the clinical evaluation of OFP and support multidisciplinary approaches to management. Further high-quality longitudinal research is needed to establish causal relationships and inform mechanism-based treatment strategies.

papers.title_zh: 胃腸道、婦科與泌尿生殖系統慢性重疊疼痛狀況（COPCs）是否為口顏面疼痛（OFP）的誘發或延續因子？系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 口顏面疼痛（OFP）是一個多維度的臨床問題，包含顳顎關節障礙（TMD）等狀況。它常與慢性重疊疼痛狀況（COPCs）相關，包括胃腸道、婦科與泌尿生殖系統疾病。儘管先前已有相關綜述，關於時序性、效應量與證據確定性仍存在不確定性。本系統性回顧與統合分析已於PROSPERO註冊，統整了評估COPCs與OFP之間關聯的觀察性研究。共22篇研究符合納入條件，其中12篇適合進行量化綜合分析。偏誤風險（RoB）以Quality in Prognosis Studies（QUIPS）工具評估，證據確定性則以GRADE方法評估。縱向研究以中等確定性顯示，大腸激躁症（IBS）會增加首發性與慢性OFP的風險，包括TMD與灼口症候群。橫斷面證據顯示胃食道逆流疾病（GERD）與TMD之間存在中等程度的關聯，多囊性卵巢症候群（PCOS）與TMD之間則有大效應量的關聯，但因方法學限制，證據確定性較低。其他狀況，如間質性膀胱炎（IC）、胃炎、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）與子宮內膜異位症，僅有有限且低確定性的證據支持。整體而言，研究結果強調在OFP臨床評估中應考量COPCs的重要性，並支持採用多學科管理方式。仍需進一步高品質的縱向研究以確立因果關係，並為以機制為基礎的治療策略提供依據。
papers.score_reason: 研究主題為口顏面疼痛與腸胃/婦科/泌尿生殖疾病的關聯，屬牙科/疼痛醫學領域，與大腸直腸外科臨床決策幾乎無關。
papers.relevance_why: 此篇聚焦於顳顎關節障礙與灼口症候群等口腔顏面疼痛，雖提及IBS、IBD、GERD，但outcome與大腸直腸外科手術或治療決策無直接關聯。
papers.one_liner: 在22篇觀察性研究中，比較有無COPCs者，發現IBS會增加OFP（如TMD、灼口症候群）風險，證據確定性中等。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；此篇為牙科/疼痛醫學領域研究，未涉及大腸直腸外科治療或手術決策。

pico.I: 存在慢性重疊疼痛狀況（COPCs），包括胃腸道、婦科、泌尿生殖系統疾病

papers.title: Association of Preoperative Prognostic Nutritional Index on Long-Term Outcomes and Postoperative Complications of Stage I-III Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Kim E, Kang J, Kim M, Yoon S, Kim M, Lee J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The prognostic nutritional index (PNI), derived from serum albumin levels and lymphocyte counts, reflects both nutritional and immunologic status. This study aimed to evaluate the association between preoperative PNI and long-term oncologic outcomes and postoperative complications in patients undergoing curative resection for colorectal cancer (CRC).
METHODS: A multicenter retrospective analysis was conducted on 3045 patients with stage I-III CRC who underwent curative surgery at five Hallym University-affiliated hospitals between 2012 and 2023. Preoperative PNI, lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio (LMR), neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) were calculated using laboratory values within 2 weeks prior to surgery. The optimal PNI cutoff for overall survival (OS) was determined by receiver operating characteristic analysis.
RESULTS: The optimal preoperative PNI cutoff was 43.4 (area under the curve = 0.643, sensitivity = 60.4%, specificity = 59.4%). Patients with low PNI (< 43.4) exhibited significantly poorer 5-year OS (59.0% vs. 80.0%, p < 0.001) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) (51.4% vs. 73.2%, p < 0.001) compared to the high PNI group. These associations remained consistent across all cancer stages. In multivariate analysis, low PNI was independently associated with OS (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.535, p < 0.001) and RFS (HR = 1.519, p < 0.001), as well as increased risk of severe complications (odds ratio = 2.503, p < 0.001). PNI showed better predictive performance than LMR, NLR, and PLR for these outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative PNI is an independent predictor of oncologic outcomes and perioperative risk in CRC patients and may serve as a practical biomarker for preoperative risk stratification.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：預後營養指數(PNI)由血清白蛋白與淋巴球計數計算而得，反映營養狀態與免疫狀態。本研究旨在評估接受根治性手術之大腸直腸癌(CRC)病人，術前PNI與長期腫瘤學預後及術後併發症之關聯。方法：本多中心回溯性分析納入2012年至2023年間於韓國Hallym大學附屬五家醫院接受根治性手術之3045名第I-III期CRC病人。術前PNI、淋巴球/單核球比值(LMR)、嗜中性球/淋巴球比值(NLR)、血小板/淋巴球比值(PLR)以術前兩週內之檢驗值計算。以受試者操作特徵曲線(ROC)分析決定預測整體存活(OS)之最佳PNI切點。結果：最佳術前PNI切點為43.4（曲線下面積=0.643，敏感度60.4%，特異度59.4%）。低PNI組(<43.4)之5年OS(59.0% vs. 80.0%, p<0.001)與無復發存活(RFS)(51.4% vs. 73.2%, p<0.001)均顯著較高PNI組差。此關聯在各期別間均一致。多變量分析顯示，低PNI是OS(風險比[HR]=1.535, p<0.001)與RFS(HR=1.519, p<0.001)之獨立預測因子，亦與嚴重併發症風險增加相關(勝算比=2.503, p<0.001)。PNI在預測這些結果上，表現優於LMR、NLR及PLR。結論：術前PNI是CRC病人腫瘤學預後及圍術期風險之獨立預測因子，可作為術前風險分層之實用生物標記。

papers.title: Quality of life assessment for colorectal cancer follow-up: A latent profile analysis of EORTC measures
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Driel M, Wullaert L, Voigt K, Doornebosch P, Peeters K, Schreinemakers J
papers.abstract:
AIM: To identify distinct health-related quality of life (HRQoL) profiles among colorectal cancer (CRC) patients using patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs), with the aim of informing more personalised follow-up strategies.
METHODS: Baseline HRQoL data from CRC patients enrolled in the FUTURE-primary study, a multicentre implementation study on home-based follow-up, were analysed. Patients completed the EORTC QLQ-C30 and QLQ-CR29 questionnaires. Aggregated symptom and function scales were developed using factor analysis and expert consensus. Latent profile analysis (LPA) was applied to identify subgroups based on PROM responses. Model selection was guided by the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), entropy, average posterior probabilities (AvePP), class sizes, clinical interpretability, and additional sensitivity and stability analyses.
RESULTS: Three HRQoL profiles were identified: low HRQoL (n = 62), intermediate HRQoL (n = 95), and high HRQoL (n = 42). The profiles followed a gradient-like pattern, with consistently high, moderate, or low scores across symptom burden and functional outcomes. Classification quality was high, as indicated by high entropy (>0.93) and average posterior probabilities (>0.96), although profile assignment should be interpreted probabilistically.
CONCLUSION: This study highlights variation in HRQoL among CRC patients. LPA identified three profiles that primarily reflected differences in overall symptom burden and functioning. These profiles may provide a preliminary framework for describing differences in supportive care needs, but their clinical applicability for tailoring follow-up or allocating care resources requires longitudinal validation.
IMPLICATIONS FOR CANCER SURVIVORS: Identifying HRQoL profiles may support more personalised follow-up, ensuring targeted care for those with higher symptom burden and lower functional scores, while reducing unnecessary interventions for others.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：運用病人自述結果測量工具（PROMs），辨識大腸直腸癌（CRC）病人中不同的健康相關生活品質（HRQoL）剖面，以期為個人化追蹤策略提供依據。方法：分析來自FUTURE-primary研究（一項居家追蹤的多中心實施型研究）中CRC病人的基線HRQoL資料。病人完成EORTC QLQ-C30與QLQ-CR29問卷。透過因子分析與專家共識建立整合性症狀與功能量表。採用潛在剖面分析（LPA）以辨識基於PROM回應的亞組。模型選擇依據貝氏資訊準則（BIC）、熵值（entropy）、平均後驗機率（AvePP）、各組樣本量、臨床可解釋性，以及額外的敏感度與穩定性分析。結果：辨識出三種HRQoL剖面：低HRQoL（n=62）、中等HRQoL（n=95）、高HRQoL（n=42）。這些剖面呈現梯度型模式，症狀負擔與功能結果的分數一致地偏高、中等或偏低。分類品質良好，熵值>0.93、平均後驗機率>0.96，但剖面歸類仍應以機率方式解讀。結論：本研究顯示CRC病人HRQoL存在差異。LPA辨識出三種主要反映整體症狀負擔與功能差異的剖面。這些剖面可能為描述支持性照護需求差異提供初步框架，但其在客製化追蹤或分配照護資源上的臨床適用性，仍需縱向驗證。對癌症存活者的意義：辨識HRQoL剖面可能有助於更個人化的追蹤，確保症狀負擔較高、功能分數較低者獲得針對性照護，同時減少對其他病人不必要的介入。

papers.title: Mechanistic remodeling and immunoregulatory functions of the B cell-humoral immunity axis in inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Zhang T, Ren Z, Zhang H, Pan Z, Chen M, Bu S
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is an immune-mediated disorder characterized by chronic inflammation of the intestinal mucosa, arising from dysregulation across multiple layers of immune control. In recent years, the contribution of B cells and humoral immunity to IBD pathogenesis has gained increasing attention. B cells participate in mucosal immune regulation through differentiation, clonal expansion, and antibody production, and are closely associated with the formation and structural organization of local tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs). Beyond antigen neutralization, antibodies can modulate inflammatory cell activation and tissue injury via Fc receptor signaling, complement activation, and immune complex-mediated responses. In parallel, intestinal barrier integrity and the extent of antigen exposure critically influence B cell activation and antibody output, forming an interconnected network of local immune processes. Therapeutic strategies targeting the B cell-humoral immunity axis are emerging, including B cell-directed therapies, modulation of antibody effector pathways, and restoration of mucosal immune function. Although accumulating evidence suggests that these approaches may confer benefits in controlling inflammation and modulating immune responses, their efficacy and applicability vary across different strategies and patient populations. In this review, we systematically integrate current evidence on B cell differentiation, local lymphoid organization, and humoral immune responses in IBD. We propose the "B cell-humoral immunity regulatory axis" as a conceptual framework to delineate mucosal immune remodeling in IBD, with the aim of advancing mechanistic understanding and informing the optimization of therapeutic interventions.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種免疫介導的疾病，其特徵為腸黏膜的慢性發炎，源自多層次免疫調控的失調。近年來，B細胞與體液免疫在IBD致病機制中的貢獻日益受到關注。B細胞透過分化、克隆擴增與抗體生成參與黏膜免疫調控，並與局部三級淋巴結構（TLS）的形成及結構組織密切相關。除了抗原中和作用外，抗體還可透過Fc受體訊號傳遞、補體活化及免疫複合物介導的反應來調節發炎細胞活化與組織損傷。同時，腸道屏障完整性與抗原暴露程度亦顯著影響B細胞活化與抗體產出，形成一個相互連結的局部免疫過程網絡。針對B細胞-體液免疫軸的治療策略正在興起，包括B細胞導向治療、抗體效應路徑調控，以及黏膜免疫功能的恢復。儘管累積的證據顯示這些方法可能有助於控制發炎與調節免疫反應，但其療效與適用性因不同策略與病人族群而異。本綜述系統性整合了目前關於B細胞分化、局部淋巴組織及IBD中體液免疫反應的證據。我們提出「B細胞-體液免疫調控軸」作為描繪IBD黏膜免疫重塑的概念性框架，旨在推進機制理解並協助優化治療介入。

papers.title: RHOA at the intersection of inflammation-driven and sporadic colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Muccioli S, Hidalgo-García L, Ngo P, Neurath M, López-Posadas R
papers.abstract: In the last decades, colorectal cancer (CRC) has emerged as a global problem, representing approximately 10% of all malignant tumors and the second leading cause of cancer-related death. Colitis-associated cancer (CAC) arises from chronic unresolved inflammation and is typically characterised by poor prognosis. Among key cellular regulators, the small GTPase RHOA controls cytoskeleton dynamics in various cell types and, thereby, key biological processes. Although it has been linked to various diseases, the role of RHOA in cancer remains controversial. RHOA has been proposed as a biomarker in cancer including CRC, but recent evidence shows that RHOA inactivation increases Wnt signalling and tumour risk in the murine intestinal epithelium. This review summarises the mechanisms of RHOA function and regulation and analyses the oncogenic pathways in which it is involved, with a focus on sporadic CRC and CAC. We discuss whether the RHOA pathway serves the same function in the two types of intestinal cancer and how the inflammatory context can modulate RHOA outcome following activation or inhibition, which still remains an open question. Finally, we address opportunities for therapeutic targeting of RHOA and related proteins. The understanding of the function of RHOA specifically in CRC may help identify limitations that might have hampered the development of novel targets for optimized treatment and/or diagnostic strategies.

papers.title: Gut microbiota-derived metabolites in gastrointestinal cancer: immunomodulatory mechanisms via the tryptophan-AhR axis and translational perspectives
papers.authors: Xing X, Ying H, Wang D, Han S
papers.abstract: The gut microbiota contributes to host physiological homeostasis through the production of diverse bioactive metabolites that orchestrate immune responses, maintain intestinal barrier integrity, and regulate metabolic signaling. Increasing evidence indicates that these microbiota-derived metabolites act as critical mediators linking microbial composition to gastrointestinal tumorigenesis. Among them, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), bile acids, and amino acid-derived metabolites-particularly tryptophan metabolites-have been most extensively studied. These metabolites influence tumor initiation and progression via multiple mechanisms, including modulation of inflammatory responses, epigenetic remodeling, control of cell proliferation and apoptosis, and reprogramming of the tumor microenvironment (TME). This review provides a systematic overview of the sources, biological functions, and mechanistic roles of major gut microbial metabolites in gastrointestinal cancer. We emphasize three interconnected regulatory axes: inflammation-immunity modulation, intestinal barrier homeostasis, and metabolism-epigenetic reprogramming, while highlighting the tryptophan-aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) axis as a central immunoregulatory hub. SCFAs generally exert protective effects by reinforcing epithelial barrier function and supporting anti-tumor immunity, whereas bile acids display context-dependent duality, with secondary bile acids being closely associated with chronic inflammation, DNA damage, and colorectal cancer progression. Tryptophan metabolites primarily shape mucosal immunity and tumor immune escape through activation of AhR signaling. Despite substantial progress, important challenges remain, including incomplete causal understanding, marked inter-individual variability, and limited clinical translation. Future studies integrating multi-omics approaches, single-cell and spatial technologies, and prospective clinical validation will be essential for defining key metabolite networks and advancing metabolite-based biomarkers and precision therapeutic strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 腸道菌群透過產生多種生物活性代謝物，協調免疫反應、維持腸道屏障完整性並調控代謝訊號，從而促進宿主生理平衡。越來越多證據顯示，這些菌群衍生代謝物是連結微生物組成與胃腸道腫瘤發生的重要媒介。其中，短鏈脂肪酸（SCFAs）、膽酸，以及胺基酸衍生代謝物——特別是色胺酸代謝物——已被最廣泛研究。這些代謝物透過多種機制影響腫瘤起始與進展，包括調節發炎反應、表觀遺傳重塑、控制細胞增殖與凋亡，以及重新編程腫瘤微環境（TME）。本綜述系統性概述主要腸道微生物代謝物在胃腸道癌症中的來源、生物功能與機轉角色。我們強調三個相互關聯的調控軸：發炎-免疫調節、腸道屏障穩態，以及代謝-表觀遺傳重塑，並著重闡述色胺酸-芳香烴受體（AhR）軸作為中樞免疫調節樞紐。SCFAs通常透過強化上皮屏障功能與支持抗腫瘤免疫發揮保護作用，而膽酸則呈現情境依賴的雙重性，次級膽酸與慢性發炎、DNA損傷及大腸直腸癌進展密切相關。色胺酸代謝物主要透過活化AhR訊號來塑造黏膜免疫與腫瘤免疫逃逸。儘管已有重大進展，仍存在重要挑戰，包括因果關係理解不完整、個體間差異顯著，以及臨床轉譯有限。未來研究整合多體學方法、單細胞與空間技術，以及前瞻性臨床驗證，將對於界定關鍵代謝物網絡以及推進以代謝物為基礎的生物標記與精準治療策略至關重要。

papers.title: RNA-binding protein RBM47 in health and disease: molecular mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges
papers.authors: Huang S, Wang Q, Shen J, Wang X, Luo T, Yin J
papers.abstract: RNA-binding motif protein 47 (RBM47) is an evolutionarily conserved multifunctional RNA-binding protein. It mediates post-transcriptional regulation through C-to-U RNA editing, alternative splicing, and messenger RNA (mRNA) stability control. Preclinical evidence indicates that RBM47 exhibits context-dependent, dual effects in human disease. In breast cancer (BC), colorectal cancer (CRC), renal cell carcinoma (RCC), papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC), and non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), experimental studies suggest that RBM47 exerts tumor-suppressive activity through the inhibition of the Wnt/β-catenin, phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)-AKT, and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathways. Conversely, in glioma and pancreatic cancer (PC), cell and animal models indicate that RBM47 exerts oncogenic activity by promoting M2 macrophage polarization and immune evasion. Furthermore, aberrant RBM47 expression has been implicated in postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and antiviral innate immune regulation in preclinical models. This review summarizes the molecular characteristics and pathological mechanisms of RBM47, discusses the preclinical rationale for its potential utility as a biomarker and therapeutic node, and critically analyzes current research limitations, conflicting evidence, and translational bottlenecks. All biomarker and therapeutic applications discussed remain at the preclinical or retrospective-correlative stage; no RBM47-targeted intervention has entered clinical trials.

papers.title: Epitranscriptomic regulation by m6A in immunity and autoimmune disorders: emerging mechanisms and clinical perspectives
papers.authors: Maqsood M, Zhan C, Hassan M, Li X, Mei L, Yang B
papers.abstract: Immune-mediated diseases arise from intricate interactions among genetic, environmental, and epigenetic factors that disrupt immune homeostasis. In recent years, epigenetic mechanisms have been widely explored as critical factors in autoreactivity. Among these modifications, N6-methyladenosine (m6A) RNA methylation stands out as a pivotal post-transcriptional regulator of immune cell function and autoimmune diseases (ADs) progression. This review outlines m6A regulation in immune microenvironments and its dual role in maintaining tolerance and promoting inflammation. This study highlights how m6A regulators, including writers (METTL3/14), erasers (FTO and ALKBH5), and readers (YTHDF1-3 and IGF2BP3), orchestrate immune cell dysfunction across systemic (systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), rheumatoid arthritis (RA), psoriasis) and organ-specific (multiple sclerosis (MS), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM), and autoimmune thyroid disease (AITD) ADs, revealing disease-specific epitranscriptomic regulatory patterns. Critically, we highlight recent therapeutic breakthroughs targeting m6A regulators, including METTL3 inhibition (STM2457) for Th17-driven MS and RA synovitis, ALKBH5 modulation (ALK-04) to mitigate psoriasis flares and neuroinflammation, FTO-targeting small molecules (Rhein) to prevent RA-associated bone erosion, and IGF2BP3 blockade (triptolide) to suppress RA fibroblast activity. Despite their promise, key challenges persist, including stage-specific effects (early vs. chronic), rare immune subset targeting (MDSCs in AIH), and concerns about the long-term safety of epitranscriptomic drugs. Future studies must address m6A dynamics in immune crosstalk to advance precision medicine strategies, particularly through combinatorial approaches with existing JAK inhibitors or checkpoint modulators.

papers.abstract_zh: 免疫介導疾病源自遺傳、環境與表觀遺傳因子間複雜交互作用，破壞免疫homeostasis。近年來，表觀遺傳機轉已被廣泛探討為自體反應性的關鍵因子。在這些修飾中，N6-methyladenosine (m6A) RNA methylation是免疫細胞功能與自體免疫疾病(ADs)進展的關鍵轉錄後調控者。本綜述概述m6A在免疫微環境中的調控及其在維持耐受性與促進發炎之間的雙重角色。本研究強調m6A調控因子，包括writers(METTL3/14)、erasers(FTO與ALKBH5)、及readers(YTHDF1-3與IGF2BP3)，如何在全身性(全身性紅斑性狼瘡(SLE)、類風濕性關節炎(RA)、乾癬)與器官特異性(多發性硬化症(MS)、發炎性腸道疾病(IBD)、第一型糖尿病(T1DM)、自體免疫甲狀腺疾病(AITD))自體免疫疾病中協調免疫細胞失調，揭示疾病特異性的表觀轉錄調控模式。關鍵地，我們強調近期針對m6A調控因子的治療突破，包括METTL3抑制(STM2457)用於Th17驅動之MS與RA滑膜炎、ALKBH5調節(ALK-04)以緩解乾癬發作與神經發炎、FTO靶向小分子(Rhein)以預防RA相關骨質侵蝕、以及IGF2BP3阻斷(triptolide)以抑制RA纖維母細胞活性。儘管前景可期，關鍵挑戰仍存在，包括分期特異性效應(早期vs慢性)、罕見免疫亞群靶向(AIH中的MDSCs)、及表觀轉錄藥物長期安全性的顧慮。未來研究必須解決免疫交互作用中的m6A動態，以推進精準醫學策略，特別是透過與現有JAK抑制劑或checkpoint調節劑的組合方法。

papers.title: Host-microbial co-metabolites: from biogenesis to immunomodulation and implications for health and disease
papers.authors: Wang Y, Zhao L, Zou Y, Nie L
papers.abstract: Host-microbial co-metabolites are small bioactive molecules generated through obligatory sequential or complementary enzymatic transformations by both gut microbiota and host tissues, including secondary bile acids, trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO), indoxyl sulfate, p-cresyl sulfate, phenylacetylglutamine, and hippurate. The dysregulation of this co-metabolic axis, often through gut microbial dysbiosis, contributes to chronic low-grade inflammation and has been implicated in inflammatory bowel disease, metabolic disorders, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, neurological disorders, and cancer. This review synthesizes the definition, biogenesis, immunomodulatory mechanisms, disease relevance, and translational biomarker potential of strict host-microbial co-metabolites.

papers.abstract_zh: 宿主-微生物共代謝物是由腸道微生物群與宿主組織透過必要的序列性或互補性酵素轉化所產生的小分子生物活性物質，包括次級膽酸、氧化三甲胺（TMAO）、硫酸吲哚酚、硫酸對甲酚、苯乙醯谷醯胺（phenylacetylglutamine）以及馬尿酸（hippurate）。這個共代謝軸的失調，通常透過腸道微生物菌相失衡（dysbiosis）發生，會導致慢性低度發炎，並牽涉炎症性腸病、代謝疾病、心血管疾病、腎臟疾病、神經系統疾病及癌症。本綜述整合了嚴格定義下宿主-微生物共代謝物的定義、生成機制、免疫調節機制、疾病相關性，以及其在轉譯醫學上作為生物標記的潛力。

papers.title: John Cunningham Virus and Colorectal Carcinogenesis: Current Evidence, Molecular Mechanisms, and Unresolved Controversies
papers.authors: Zhou Z, Wang Z, Xi L, Song N
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide, prompting ongoing research into infectious agents that may contribute to colorectal carcinogenesis. Among candidate oncogenic viruses, JC polyomavirus (JCPyV), a ubiquitous human polyomavirus, has attracted considerable attention due to its potential involvement in tumour initiation and progression. Although several studies have reported the presence of JCPyV viral DNA, transcripts, and proteins in colorectal adenomas and carcinomas, the prevalence and clinical significance of these findings vary considerably across populations and diagnostic methods. Mechanistically, the viral Large T Antigen (TAg) is implicated in several oncogenic processes through its interactions with key cellular regulators, including p53, retinoblastoma protein (pRb), and components of the Wnt/β-catenin signalling pathway. These interactions may cause genomic instability, aberrant cell cycle progression, impaired DNA repair, and aberrant cell proliferation, thereby creating an environment conducive to malignant transformation. In addition, emerging evidence suggests that JCPyV may contribute to chromosomal instability and epigenetic changes that facilitate tumour progression. Despite these observations, the causal role of JCPyV in colorectal cancer remains controversial. Inconsistent epidemiological data, discrepancies in virus detection, geographic variation, and the inability to confirm direct causation of carcinogenesis have generated ongoing debates about the involvement of JCPyV as a stimulator factor or cofactor in colorectal tumourigenesis. This review critically evaluates the current evidence linking JCPyV to colorectal cancer, summarises the proposed molecular mechanisms of viral carcinogenesis, and highlights key unresolved questions that need to be addressed to clarify the biological and clinical significance of JCPyV in colorectal carcinogenesis.

papers.title_zh: JC病毒與大腸直腸癌致癌機轉：現行證據、分子機制與未解爭議
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球癌症死亡的主要原因之一，促使研究持續探討可能參與大腸直腸致癌機轉的感染性因子。在候選致癌病毒中，JC多瘤病毒（JCPyV）作為一種普遍存在的人類多瘤病毒，因其可能參與腫瘤起始與進展而受到相當關注。雖然已有多項研究報告在大腸直腸腺瘤與癌組織中檢測到JCPyV病毒DNA、轉錄本與蛋白質，但這些發現的盛行率與臨床意義在不同族群與診斷方法間差異甚大。機轉上，病毒的大T抗原（TAg）透過與關鍵細胞調控因子（包括p53、視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白pRb，以及Wnt/β-catenin訊號路徑成分）交互作用，被認為參與多種致癌過程。這些交互作用可能導致基因體不穩定性、異常細胞週期進展、DNA修復受損及異常細胞增生，從而創造有利於惡性轉化的環境。此外，新興證據顯示JCPyV可能促成染色體不穩定性與表觀遺傳變化，助長腫瘤進展。儘管有這些觀察，JCPyV在大腸直腸癌中的因果角色仍具爭議。不一致的流行病學數據、病毒檢測方法的差異、地理變異，以及無法確認其對致癌作用的直接因果關係，使得JCPyV作為刺激因子或協同因子在大腸直腸腫瘤發生中的角色持續存在爭論。本綜述批判性評估目前將JCPyV與大腸直腸癌相連結的證據，總結所提出的病毒致癌分子機轉，並強調需要解決的關鍵未解問題，以釐清JCPyV在大腸直腸致癌機轉中的生物學與臨床意義。

papers.title: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
papers.abstract: Sclerosing cholangitis encompasses a spectrum of disorders, characterised by multi-level biliary stricturing. The prefix 'primary' refers to the commonest form, PSC. Although rare, incidence and prevalence are rising, which when coupled with the absence of life-prolonging therapy has resulted in PSC being one of the lead indications for liver transplantation. Herein, we present a clinically focussed overview of PSC epidemiology, natural history, and nuances surrounding monitoring and surveillance. We go on to discuss how gut inflammation may affect the clinical course that patients experience, whilst giving way to bile acid therapies, molecularly targeted antifibrotics, and a bevy of microbiome-based interventions.

papers.title: Effects of cuproptosis and its application in inflammatory bowel disease (Review)
papers.authors: Chen L, Akanyibah F, Guan J, Pei B, Wang B, Mao F
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which includes ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, is a common, recurring, chronic intestinal inflammatory illness that is considered to be impacted by the immune system, gut microbiota and genetic factors. Copper (Cu), a crucial metal ion in cuproptosis, contributes to IBD, with studies revealing that its dysregulation contributes to oxidative stress, intestinal inflammation, gut dysbiosis and disruption of barrier integrity. Additionally, cuproptosis‑related genes have been implicated in the pathogenesis of IBD, characterized by defects in barrier integrity and enhanced immune responses. These genes have been identified as biomarkers of IBD, providing novel therapeutic strategies for exploring their treatment. The present review highlights the mechanism of cuproptosis and the role of Cu in IBD. The review also highlights the cuproptosis‑related genes in the pathogenesis of IBD, as well as their applications as biomarkers for therapeutic purposes. These biomarkers may provide a reference for IBD for clinical decision‑making. The primary challenge is the lack of standard clinical medications for treating IBD associated with cuproptosis‑related genes. Consequently, researchers are employing molecular docking and other techniques to identify potential drugs aimed at these genes for therapeutic purposes.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）包括潰瘍性大腸炎與克隆氏症，是一種常見、反覆發作的慢性腸道發炎疾病，被認為受免疫系統、腸道菌叢與基因因素影響。銅（Cu）是銅死亡（cuproptosis）中的關鍵金屬離子，與IBD有關，研究顯示其失調會導致氧化壓力、腸道發炎、腸道菌叢失衡及屏障完整性破壞。此外，銅死亡相關基因也被牽涉於IBD的致病機轉中，其特徵為屏障完整性缺陷及免疫反應增強。這些基因已被鑑定為IBD的生物標記，為探索其治療提供新的治療策略。本綜述重點闡述銅死亡的機制及銅在IBD中的角色，同時也闡述銅死亡相關基因於IBD致病機轉中的作用，以及其作為治療用生物標記的應用。這些生物標記可能為IBD的臨床決策提供參考。主要挑戰在於目前缺乏針對銅死亡相關基因治療IBD的標準臨床用藥。因此，研究者正運用分子對接（molecular docking）等技術，嘗試針對這些基因鑑定潛在藥物以達成治療目的。

papers.title: Carbonic anhydrase XIII
papers.abstract: Carbonic anhydrase XIII (CA XIII) is a recently identified member of the α-carbonic anhydrase family and a cytosolic enzyme with conserved structural and catalytic features. Since its discovery in 2004, its gene organization, protein structure, catalytic mechanism, and inhibition profile have been extensively characterized. CA XIII exhibits moderate catalytic activity compared to other cytosolic isozymes, with differences in proton transfer dynamics accounting for its distinct efficiency. The enzyme is widely expressed in human tissues, particularly in epithelial and reproductive systems, suggesting roles in pH regulation, bicarbonate metabolism, and tissue homeostasis. Despite this, its physiological function remains incompletely defined. Emerging evidence links CA XIII to pathological processes, including its downregulation in colorectal cancer and tumor-suppressive effects in breast cancer models. In contrast, studies in acute myeloid leukemia indicate a context-dependent role in cell proliferation and drug response. Associations with inflammatory conditions, aging, and cognition further suggest broader biological relevance. Pharmacologically, CA XIII is sensitive to sulfonamide inhibitors and activators, making it a relevant target for isozyme-selective drug design. However, the lack of in vivo models remains a major limitation, highlighting the need for integrative future studies.
papers.title_zh: 碳酸酐酶 XIII（Carbonic anhydrase XIII）
papers.abstract_zh: 碳酸酐酶 XIII（CA XIII）是α-碳酸酐酶家族中最近被發現的一員，為具有保守結構與催化特徵的細胞質酵素。自2004年被發現以來，其基因組織、蛋白質結構、催化機制與抑制特性已被廣泛研究。相較於其他細胞質同工酶，CA XIII展現中等程度的催化活性，其質子轉移動力學的差異可解釋其獨特的效率。此酵素廣泛表現於人類組織中，特別是上皮系統與生殖系統，暗示其可能參與pH調節、碳酸氫鹽代謝與組織恆定。儘管如此，其生理功能仍未完全釐清。新興證據將CA XIII與病理過程連結，包括其在大腸直腸癌中的表現下降，以及在乳癌模型中的腫瘤抑制效果。相對地，急性骨髓性白血病的研究顯示其在細胞增生與藥物反應中扮演隨情境而異的角色。與發炎狀態、老化及認知功能的關聯，進一步顯示其更廣泛的生物學重要性。在藥理學上，CA XIII對磺醯胺類抑制劑與活化劑敏感，使其成為同工酶選擇性藥物設計的相關標的。然而，缺乏活體動物模型仍是主要限制，凸顯未來需要進行整合性研究。
